Chapter 495: Chapter 3 Sala: Our Chance is Here! (Please Subscribe)_2

“Respected Scholar Lin Yuan, with your current status, you could apply to actively leave the Milky Way Star Region and proceed to the safer inner territories of human civilization…”

The Goddess of Wisdom actively suggested.

“Leave now…” Lin Yuan thought it over.

Now he had made many investments in the Milky Way Star Region, including the transformation of a Grade B planet worth a hundred thousand Cosmic Crystals and so on.

“Forget it.”

Lin Yuan declined.

...

The suggestion from the Goddess of Wisdom for him to go to the inner territories of human civilization was merely out of concern for his safety.

But safety concerns?

If it were before the eighth wormhole shuttle, Lin Yuan would indeed have had such worries.

But now?

Lin Yuan, who had comprehended dozens of Cosmic Forces, could crush those unbeatable at the Eighth Layer, even if his Inner World had not yet recovered to its peak.

Even without regaining all his strength, he could handle a few moves against Nineth Rank strong individuals.

There were simply no safety concerns.

The ones who should worry are the Different Species.

“Respected Scholar Lin Yuan, you can still preside over the Milky Way Star Region before your scholar status is exposed. If it is revealed, please proceed to the inner territories of human civilization…”

The Goddess of Wisdom fell silent for a while, then gave a reply.

The talent and aptitude that Lin Yuan was exhibiting now could be considered a top monstrous genius among human civilization, likely not to provoke an overt reaction from Different Species to attack him openly.

But if the evolutionary scholar status is exposed, it’s highly possible that the Different Species might actively break the unspoken agreement.

A top monstrous genius of human civilization might not attract the attention of the Peak Clans, and a single evolutionary scholar might also find it difficult to provoke an all-out response from these clans. But when combined…

“Understood…”

Lin Yuan nodded.

…

Chikun Star Realm Virtual World.

Central Plaza Area.

Many Evolvers were whispering amongst themselves.

“It’s been almost twenty years, hasn’t the Martial Path Evolutionary Path released the Eighth Layer Part yet?”

An Evolver raised the question, noting that the Martial Path Evolutionary Path still occupied the second rank in the Chikun Evolution Rankings without any sign of slipping.

“Eighth Layer Part?”

“Is the Eighth Layer Part so easy to come by?”

A green-eyed Evolver scoffed, implying that even for the high and mighty evolutionary scholars, carving out a complete Eighth Layer Evolutionary Path was not an easy task.

Otherwise, why would there be so few Eighth Layer Evolutionary Paths in human civilization?

Moreover, the Eighth Layer Part of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is far from being as simple as a normal Eighth Layer Part.

Considering the potential shown by the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the difficulty in carving out a matching Eighth Layer Part would be immensely higher than other Eighth Layer Parts.

“I think the founder of the Martial Path, even if capable of creating the Eighth Layer Part, would spend hundreds, even thousands of years, or perhaps even more…”

The green-eyed Evolver left unsaid that it might be possible that the Eighth Stage Martial Tao Part could not be created at all.

“I don’t care.”

“The founder of the Martial Path will definitely be able to create the Eighth Layer Part.”

Many of Lin Yuan’s ‘fans’ immediately expressed their opinions.

With such popularity for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, it naturally accumulated a large number of enthusiasts, and consequently, Lin Yuan, as the founder, also had many ‘fans’.

“Sure, sure, sure.”

The green-eyed Evolver did not care to argue.

This wasn’t his opinion, but the belief of many higher-level Evolvers and citizens.

It was easy for the founder of the Martial Path to create parts from the First to the Seventh Rank, but to create the Eighth Layer Part matching the previous seven ranks was merely hopeful.

Suddenly—

The time reached early morning.

The Chikun Evolution Rankings began to ‘refresh’.

A few breaths later.

In the Central Plaza Area, all the Evolvers looked up at the rankings.

The green-eyed Evolver did as well, and upon seeing the name at the top of the rankings, was momentarily stunned.

“The Martial Path Evolutionary Path is first now?” The green-eyed Evolver’s heart trembled a bit. The rise in the ranking wasn’t much, just by one.

But it was the top rank.

And it also indicated something even more terrifying.

That was the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had been updated, and the Eighth Layer Part was uploaded.

Although there had been a previous occurrence where the Martial Path Evolutionary Path experienced a substantial rise in rankings without uploading a new part, this instance signified a different outcome.

But that possibility seemed unlikely.

Upon this thought, the green-eyed evolver immediately opened the detailed page of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path and discovered, right after the Seventh Rank Chapter, the three characters for the Eighth Layer Part.

“Has the Eighth Layer Part really been developed?”

The green-eyed evolver felt as if he were dreaming, had he just witnessed the birth of an Eighth Stage Evolutionary Path?

And it was the extremely exceptional Martial Path Evolutionary Path?

“Let’s take a look at the Annan Star Alliance Evolution Rankings…” Merely the Chikun Evolution Rankings in the Star Domain couldn’t explain whether the Eighth Stage Martial Tao was congruent with the previous ranks from First to Seventh.

Comparatively, even the Martial Path Evolutionary Path with only up to the Seventh Rank was already approaching the upper limit of the Chikun Evolution Rankings.

Even a slight advancement to the Eighth Stage of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would be enough to take the top spot on the Chikun Evolution Rankings.

This isn’t due to the Eighth Stage Martial Tao’s own merits, but rather because the previous ranks from One to Seven were too heaven-defying.

“Annan Star Alliance Evolution Rankings…” The green-eyed evolver was about to look from the bottom up.

He remembered that the Martial Path Evolutionary Path used to rank one hundredth on the Annan Star Alliance Evolution Rankings.

Even if it improved, there was a high probability it wouldn’t reach the top fifty.

However.

Just as the green-eyed evolver’s gaze glanced downward from the top of the rankings.

He was suddenly dumbstruck.

Because the name currently at the number one spot of the Annan Star Alliance Evolution Rankings…

“The Martial Path Evolutionary Path… has reached the summit of the Annan Evolution Rankings?”

The green-eyed evolver swallowed hard, his mind in a muddle.

…

Milky Way Star Region.

A fleet was rapidly traveling through wormholes.

“Our mission target this time is the Main Star of the Milky Way Star Domain,” said Captain Nolan, tasked with adjusting the fleet’s position to ensure the correct trajectory.

“Captain, this much Tai Micro Clear Crystal almost drained our group’s stockpile, was it bought by the Galaxy Master?” asked the curious deputy captain.

An enormous quantity of Tai Micro Clear Crystals, equivalent to eighty thousand cubic universe crystals, even when carried in spatial equipment, filled nearly half the fleet.

Tai Micro Clear Crystal contains pure energy, but its price isn’t high; eighty thousand cubic universe crystals worth of Tai Micro Clear Crystal… piled together, it’s estimated to be the size of several hundred planets.

“Not sure,” responded Captain Nolan with an impassive face.

All members of the fleet were guessing it was the doing of the Galaxy Master because in the whole Milky Way Main Star, aside from that immensely powerful and wealthy Galaxy Master, who else had the means to purchase so much Tai Micro Clear Crystal?

Eighty thousand cubic universe crystals… that’s a vast fortune, more than many Eighth Rank Evolvers could earn in their lifetimes.

“What kind of existence is the Galaxy Master, and whether he buys something, is it something you can discuss?” Captain Nolan still glanced at the deputy captain, warning, “The most important task for our group right now is to deliver these Tai Micro Clear Crystals to the Milky Way Main Star, as for whom they are for, that’s not for you to ask.”

“Yes, yes, yes,” the deputy captain immediately complied, also feeling somewhat scared.

Everything within the fleet was monitored by the Goddess of Wisdom; if they rashly discussed the Galaxy Master and it were recorded by the Goddess, they would definitely be in deep trouble.

“We’ve arrived,” announced Captain Nolan after performing the last wormhole shuttle, arriving outside the Milky Way Main Star.

…

“The Tai Micro Clear Crystals have arrived?” Lin Yuan looked up towards the fleet stopped outside the main star.

“One by one it’s too slow, I’ll just go get them myself,” said Lin Yuan, vanishing from his spot and appearing outside the Milky Way Main Star.

“Galaxy Master,” acknowledged Captain Nolan, who naturally knew who had purchased this batch of Tai Micro Clear Crystals; upon seeing Lin Yuan, he immediately greeted him with respect.

…

Just as Lin Yuan’s figure appeared outside the Milky Way Main Star.

Five invincible figures from the Eighth Rank, hidden deep within multiple spatial layers, suddenly had their eyes light up.

They had been lying in wait for more than ten years, just for this moment; waiting for the Galaxy Master to leave the main star, waiting for the Galaxy Master to lose the protection of the primary star.

Without the main star’s Planetary Defense System, the Galaxy Master, a newly advanced evolver of the Eighth Stage, appeared in their eyes like an undefended little white rabbit.

“Our chance has come,” they said.

“Strike now!” cried out Sarath of the Dark Scale Race, being the first to break away from the spatial layers.

The other four invincible Eighth Rankers followed suit, excitedly rushing towards Lin Yuan.
